script.problem: The one line is more than one sentence.

terra.problem: None of the moments happens at Cyrene: Simon carries the cross on the way to Golgotha, the Pentecost event happens in Jerusalem, and the last two moments happen in Antioch.

The line says people from Cyrene appear at the cross and at Pentecost. The verses place Simon carrying the cross on the way to Golgotha, not necessarily at the crucifixion. They mention people from parts of Libya near Cyrene at Pentecost, not specifically from the city.
Acts 2:9–12 does not itself say that the Spirit came or that the people were in Jerusalem. Those details appear earlier in Acts 2.
